query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "transitlm: a large-scale dataset and benchmark for map-free transit ro" linguistics
rationale: The paper is a broad survey on applying LLMs to general transportation systems (traffic prediction, autonomous driving) and does not address the specific "linguistics" aspect or the "map-free transit routing" mechanism central to the user's question about extending the TransitLM dataset. It fails to meet criteria (a) or (b) as it does not measure the same biological/algorithmic mechanism or variables (linguistic properties of transit data) but rather discusses high-level application categories.
